product_title: Handcrafted Ganesha Lotus Pearl Door Hanging Set
product_description: Decorate your entrance with this handcrafted hanging set featuring Lord Ganesha motifs, pink lotus designs, golden detailing, colourful embellishments, and pearl tassels. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, weddings, and festive home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water and harsh cleaning chemicals.
Handle pearl tassels and decorative elements carefully.
Keep away from excessive moisture and prolonged direct sunlight.
Store flat in a dry, protective box when not in use.
